About petwellhub

Pet adoption and care guidance citing AVMA guidelines and peer-reviewed veterinary literature.

¶ Editorial mission

Editorial Mission

petwellhub is a curation publication that aggregates primary sources (government statistics, peer-reviewed research, manufacturer data, and verified industry sources) within a single subject domain. We do not publish personal opinions or experience-based reviews — every claim is backed by citable data with linked sources.

Our Editorial Values

  • Data First — Every comparison is grounded in official sources.
  • No Sponsored Placements — We never accept payment for recommendations. Affiliate disclosure in footer.
  • Transparency — Content is produced with AI assistance; all data is verified against primary sources.
  • Verifiability — Every source is linked inline for direct verification.

Contact for Corrections, Tips, or Partnerships

Email: editor@petwellhub.org
